project_identity.name: Odoo CRM Replica
core_principles: High Contrast (White Text on Dark Cards)

font_family.primary: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
font_family.headings: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
font_family.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

kpi_card.structure: flex flex-col justify-between p-4 h-full relative group cursor-pointer
kpi_card.hover_actions: absolute top-2 right-2 flex gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity bg-black/20 rounded p-1

edit_modal.sidebar: col-span-12 md:col-span-7 lg:col-span-8 border-r p-6 overflow-y-auto
edit_modal.preview: col-span-12 md:col-span-5 lg:col-span-4 bg-gray-50 p-6 flex items-center justify-center

tabs.list: w-full justify-start border-b rounded-none h-auto p-0
tabs.trigger: data-[state=active]:bg-transparent data-[state=active]:shadow-none data-[state=active]:border-b-2 data-[state=active]:border-primary rounded-none px-4 py-3

chart_selector.item: flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 border rounded hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground cursor-pointer data-[selected=true]:border-primary data-[selected=true]:bg-primary/5

universal_guidelines: KPI cards must be solid flat colors from the provided palette.
Do not use gradients on KPI cards.
All interactive elements must have hover states.
The 'Edit Chart' modal must show a live preview of the component being edited.
Use Shadcn UI components for all form elements (Select, Input, Switch, Slider).
Charts must use Recharts via the Shadcn Chart component.
Ensure 'Won Top 10' and 'Lost Top 10' lists are clear and legible.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a pixel-perfect replica of the Odoo CRM dashboard. Prioritize functionality and information density over artistic whitespace. The layout is dense. The 'Edit Chart' modal is the core complexity - ensure it handles all configuration state (type, color, data, title) and reflects it immediately in the preview. Use the provided color palette strictly.
